Great Food, Beautiful Location, Fun Cooking Class
Sep 2025 • Solo
I came for the cooking class with Trinh. I enjoyed it very much. It was much more than a cooking class. It was shopping, farming, and fishing as well. We started with a Vietnamese ice coffee, which was the best coffee I’ve ever had. The sweetness is unique and my first guess was coconut. It was not, but the flavor is in the soft vanilla sweetness palate. We then went to the market. I ate a Quả Mận rose apple and it was so good. A red fruit that is sweet but not too sweet. I bought some coffee to take home. After that was farming and fishing. I helped to plant some herbs in a small plot and I casted a fishing net after first watching the fisherman do it. The last thing was the cooking class.
They gave me fresh passion fruit to welcome me to the restaurant. I also got a leg and foot massage, which is great for anyone who really participated as much as they could with farming and fishing. Trinh led the cooking class. We made a Sweet & Sour fish sauce, tam hũ'u, Bánh Xèo Hoi An crispy rice cake, Bánh Tráng U'ó't rice paper, and Bánh Cuốn Nóng Tôm Thit Nấm. Everything was very very good, I enjoyed everything I ate. I am not the best cook but Trinh is a great teacher. She will work with you. When you have cooked everything you get a certificate of achievement for successfully completing the cooking class. After that, they gave me several other dishes to try, and I loved all of those too. They gave me sea bass, a sweet potato and rice sweet dish, soup, and a sweet gelatin that tasted like candy. The colors of the restaurant are beautiful and the open view side on the other side of the tables give a very relaxing atmosphere. I would come here to eat even if I didn’t do the cooking class. This was a great experience for me.
